ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central regions on both lobes; continuous black pigmentation along the trailing edge and distal tips; two distinct circular black focal spots on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal vertex angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations between 2-8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch and terminating at acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent dark circular clusters on the upper-right lobe; secondary cluster of smaller dark spots on the lower-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned dark linear streaks oriented diagonally on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct focal pigmentation spots on the right lobe and irregular indentations along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric dark pigmentation intrusion at the fluke-peduncle junction extending into the central white regions.
